race.comment: OUR ANCHORAGE (1) has tackled some pretty handy opposition back in Sydney since resuming and will get a pleasant surprise when he scans the mounting yard. Gets an important 2kg claim to aid the big weight and will run the trip. Big chance. THINKHARDANDFAST (9) is yet to strike this campaign but gets in at featherweight and is sure to punch up from the inside draw and give them something to catch. PRINCE LEVI (2) doesn't win out of turn but comes through stronger racing and drops back to a pet trip. Isn't without a winning hope. BECAMO (7) is in good touch and can't be left out of exotics, while KIPLING'S JOURNEY (5) could relish this sharp rise in trip at this point of the prep.
